title: RollupBridge Inspector
subtitle: Admin Sandbox: Multi-Tenant Storage, Vault & Hardware Diagnostics
description: Developer diagnostic console to inspect per-user storage isolation, test Android WebAPK capabilities, and verify multi-user permissions.
tagline: Admin Multi-Tenant Diagnostic Console • Session Verification, Live ACL Matrix & Storage Namespace Inspector

quickstart.detail: Bridge Lab is gated with `visibility: admin_only`. Non-admin testers attempting to open its URL are automatically blocked by `RollupBridge.enforceAccessGate`.
Check Panel 1 (`Active Session & Role Verification`) to inspect the hydrated user object, Google email, role badge, and admin flags.

quickstart.step: Audit the Live Access Control Matrix (ACL)
quickstart.detail: Inspect Panel 2 (`Live Hub Access Control Matrix`) to confirm exact `authorized_apps` arrays and `default_app_configs` synced from `registry.json` or mobile Admin edits.
Review Panel 3 to audit every isolated per-user storage key, secret vault key name, and OTA `installed_ledger` entry stored on the current device.

navigation_map.purpose: Displays complete multi-user permission dictionary from `RollupBridge.auth.getACL()`.
Sorted inventory of all `rollup::v1::*` keys in `localStorage` for isolation auditing.
Quick access to storage reset tools and this diagnostic User Manual PDF.

deep_dive_features.title: Zero-Trust Namespace Verification
deep_dive_features.body: Confirms visually that every app writes strictly under `rollup::v1::u::<email>::app::<appId>::<key>`, preventing cross-user or cross-cartridge state collisions.

pro_tips: Use `👁️ Preview as User` in Hub Admin Mode first, then check which apps remain visible—confirming `admin_only` cartridges like Bridge Lab stay hidden from testers.
